responsibility: Provides a transactional hash-map abstraction that supports taking snapshots and later committing or rolling back mutations through an undo log. The main implementation defines the snapshot-aware map, its undo records, alternate borrowed views, and the logic for replaying logged inserts, removals, and overwrites back onto the underlying map, while the tests validate that these snapshot, nested commit, rollback, and misuse-detection semantics behave correctly.
